title: Nasty Liq Mineral Water 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid By Nasty Juice
description: Nasty Liq's Mineral Water is a breakthrough in the e-liquid space, offering a pure and refreshing experience that stands apart from the typical fruit and dessert flavours. Inspired by the clear and revitalizing taste of a natural spring, this e-liquid captures the essence of purity in a vape, providing a crisp and hydrating sensation that's as refreshing as it is unique. Every inhale is like a drink of cool, refreshing water on a hot day, leaving a clean and invigorating feeling that purifies the palate. It’s a subtle flavour, yet it makes a bold statement, stripping away the complexities of heavier blends and focusing on a simple, yet profound, vaping experience. The beauty of this e-liquid lies in its simplicity and its ability to deliver a sensation that's both grounding and exhilarating. It's the ideal choice for vapers who are looking for something different from their vaping experience—something that's not about overpowering the senses, but rather about offering a moment of clarity and refreshment. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the Nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape kit devices. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more delicious Nasty Liq flavours to try. Nasty Juice have fine-tuned their vape juices for optimised performance with the vast majority of MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices. They feature exceptional flavours and flavour blends across fruits, sweets, desserts and tobacco and many are also available in Nasty Juice’s super-convenient Nasty Bar disposable vape bars.
